changeSet.author: mherman22
changeSet.comment: Add FREEZER_OFFLINE to alert_type CHECK constraint so an unresponsive device can raise its own alert. The constraint is redeclared wholesale by every changeset that touches it, so this list is 086's union plus FREEZER_OFFLINE. The "must be last" invariant has moved to 092, which redeclares the constraint again to add FREEZER_HUMIDITY - no changeset anywhere in base-changelog.xml may redeclare chk_alert_type after 092, including the analyzer/ and qc/ changelogs, which base-changelog.xml includes after 3.5.x.x/base.xml.
